title: ZohoUploadResult
description: Outcome of a Zoho Books write (GL post, invoice issue, payment post, credit note). Carries §9 AR_* codes and the idempotency key used (§10).

code.description: Stable AR_* code (§9). AR_DUPLICATE = safe idempotent replay (same key).

idempotency_key.description: The key sent on the POST; identical on retry/resume (§10).

zoho_id.description: Native id of the created/updated Zoho object.

duplicate.description: True when Zoho reported a safe duplicate of the same idempotency key (code=AR_DUPLICATE).

raw_response_ref.description: Opaque reference to the stored raw response (never inlined; §9).

attempts.description: Number of attempts made (≤3 transient per §10).
